data.name: Potions of Veldenkeep
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Veldenkeep — a bustling medieval city that houses one of the greatest Adventurers’ Guilds in the land. Heroes from far and wide gather here to prepare for their quests — and they’ll need your potions to survive. In this first-person alchemist shop simulator, you’ll cultivate rare plants, brew powerful elixirs, and serve adventurers, peasants, and nobles alike.

🌱 Grow & Harvest: Care for herbs, roots, and mystical plants. Nurture them with water, warmth, and patience.

⚗️ Brew & Experiment: Mix ingredients at your brewing station. Perfect timing can mean the difference between a soothing healing potion and a bitter failure.

🛡️ Supply the Adventurers: From antidotes to protective concoctions, equip brave guild members with the potions they need for their journeys. Your reputation may spread far beyond the city walls.

💰 Sell & Trade: Place your potions on shelves, set your own prices, and watch how villagers and adventurers react. Fair trades earn loyalty — while greed may drive them away.

🏪 Run the Shop: Organize displays, decorate your cozy alchemist’s corner, and balance daily rent with your gold.

👥 Meet the Locals: From humble farmers to eccentric nobles, and adventurers preparing for their next dungeon crawl — each customer has unique needs and spending habits.

⭐ Grow Your Reputation: Expand your shop, unlock new recipes, and rise from a humble herbalist to Veldenkeep’s most trusted Potion Master.

Your journey begins in Elderhen, a quiet rural village on the outskirts of Veldenkeep. Here, you’ll learn the basics of alchemy, serve simple folk, and take your first steps as a potion maker. But Elderhen is only the beginning…

Whether you’re carefully managing gold and reputation, or simply enjoying the cozy rhythm of tending plants and helping adventurers prepare for their quests, Potions of Veldenkeep offers a relaxing yet rewarding experience of alchemy and shopkeeping.

English*, French, Italian, German, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / Ryzen 3 1200 (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / Radeon RX 560 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 1600 (6 cores) or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 (6 GB) or Radeon RX 5600 XT / RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible device
